name: NumberGrid-74x74-bethrezens_retreat
battle_recovery: Living units regenerate by native unit + lord + either fort or own-land bonus, rounded up once. City/capital recovery and recruitment require ownership; paid healing/revival still require the capital temple. Victory preserves wounds. Entry with a living hero captures cities only after both defenders are defeated.
battle_engagement: A directional command targeting a living enemy stack starts combat from the current tile. Passing beside a stack is safe. Entry costs ceil(half the full movement allowance), capped at remaining points; zero points forbids attack. Victory and retreat keep the attacker on its original tile.
reference_source: Steam Rise of the Elves Scens/S101; docs/maps/bethrezens_retreat/layout.json
